_README: THE ONLY FILE IN THIS REPO THAT MAY CONTAIN A HOSTNAME. Everything SEO-visible (canonical, hreflang, Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemaps, robots.txt, watch pages) is generated from here by scripts/gen_seo.py. To move to the real domains: edit canonicalOrigin, then re-run `python3 scripts/gen_seo.py` and `python3 scripts/build_deploy.py`. Nothing else changes.
_noindex: Set true for dev/staging/preview so Google indexes nothing. This writes <meta name=robots content=noindex>. Do NOT use robots.txt to noindex — a block stops the crawl, so Google can never see the directive.
_canonicalOrigin: Absolute origin with NO trailing slash. When the .ir and .com domains exist, ir becomes e.g. https://nurseplus.ir and com becomes https://nurseplus.com. Until then both legitimately share the GitHub Pages host and differ only by base.
_base: Path prefix inside canonicalOrigin. On GitHub Pages today the .com site lives in /com/. When .com moves to its own domain root, set both to '/' and set build_deploy.py to emit two separate packages — gen_seo.py needs no other change.
_org: org.urlPlaceholder is used only in WebSite/Organization JSON-LD. Replace it with the real site URL at launch; leaving a placeholder is better than shipping a wrong domain.

social._twitter: @handle — leave empty until the account exists. Never invent a verification code or handle.
social._gscProperty: Google Search Console HTML-tag verification string. Leave empty; never fabricate one.
